nodes.text: Does there exist some $c>0$ such that, for any $K>1$, whenever $A$ is a sufficiently large finite multiset of positive integers with $\sum_{n\in A}\frac{1}{n}>K$ there exists some $S\subseteq A$ such that\[1-e^{-cK} < \sum_{n\in S}\frac{1}{n}\leq 1?\]

#312 : [ErGr80] number theory | unit fractions Erdős and Graham knew this with $e^{-cK}$ replaced by $c/K^2$.
